messages:
maya - Product: Quick sync proposal — can we do a 1hr cross-functional meeting next Wed 11:00am PT to cover roadmap, open RFCs, and priority triage? Who can own agenda + pre-reads?
liam - Eng: Wed 11 works for infra team. I can help draft agenda.
sofia - Eng: Heads up I have a calendar conflict Wed 11–12. Thurs 10am PT is better for me.
chris - EngM: Wed 11 is ok for me but would like 20–30 minutes reserved for runtime perf/RFC follow-up.
anika - Design: We have two design touchpoints (routing UI + canary UX). I can add mockups to the pre-read.
maya - Product: Great — sounds like agenda owner needed. liam, can you take ownership and add items? I'll set the invite if we lock time. :calendar:
liam - Eng: I can own. Draft agenda below, open to edits:
```
- Intros + goals (5m)
- Quick wins / release highlights (5m)
- RFC reviews: svc-mesh (15m), routing fallback (15m)
- Runtime perf deep-dive (20m)
- Triage / priority decisions (10m)
- Action items & owners (5m)
```
sofia - Eng: Can we trim runtime perf to 15m and move deeper discussion to a follow-up for runtime team? We risk running overtime.
chris - EngM: +1 to keeping runtime 20 if possible; we have a blocker that affects Dedicated SLOs. If we trim, please ensure we have a concrete follow-up.
maya - Product: Ok compromise — runtime 15m in main slot, if decision needed we spin out a separate 30m follow-up in the same week.
anika - Design: I'll add the design slides and label which items need decisions so folks can pre-read. Link: https://drive.redwood/example/designs (please add comments)
liam - Eng: Added agenda to the doc and included RFC links: https://git.redwood/rfcs/svc-mesh, https://git.redwood/rfcs/routing-fallback
sofia - Eng: Can owners add 2–3 bullet pre-read notes (what to look for) next to each RFC? Saves time in the meeting.
maya - Product: Yes — owners, please add pre-read notes by EOD Tue. Also tagging folks for priority disputes: @sofia - Eng, @chris - EngM, @anika - Design.
liam - Eng: Noted. I'll also ping for any blocked CR reviews that should be escalated in the triage section.
maya - Product: Calendar question — do we want recurring weekly or biweekly? I think weekly for the next 4 weeks while roadmap + RFCs are active, then reassess.
chris - EngM: Weekly for 4 weeks sounds right. :thumbsup:
sofia - Eng: Fine with weekly for ramp, then biweekly.
deploy-bot: Meeting created — "Crossfunc Eng/Product Sync" Wed 11:00am PT, invites sent to maya, liam, sofia, chris, anika.
liam - Eng: I'll own agenda updates and the doc. If folks have conflict with Wed 11, reply here now so I can adjust before I send the final invite.
maya - Product: Also, quick ask — can someone volunteer to take notes/decision log? We should capture decision rationale and action owners for the decision log repo.
anika - Design: I can take notes this week.
sofia - Eng: happy to alternate next week.
maya - Product: Awesome — thanks. We'll add a short decision log entry after the meeting and link to the RFCs.
liam - Eng: Final ask — please add any discussion topics to the doc under "parking lot" so we don't run overtime.
maya - Product: Perfect. I'll send the invite once liam confirms the time (Wed 11 unless enough objections).
sofia - Eng: If a few folks can't make Wed, prefer Thurs 10 — vote here: :one: Wed 11, :two: Thurs 10
liam - Eng: Voting now: I pick :one: but can accept :two: if needed.
chris - EngM: :one:
anika - Design: :one:
maya - Product: :one: (lean)
sofia - Eng: :two: (still prefer)
liam - Eng: Looks like majority Wed 11. I'll lock Wed 11, invite sent by EOD. Thanks everyone. :tada:
